g.text: Equilibrium stages and transfer units are different ways to describe contact height
Illustrative matching packing-height descriptions. N_eq and NTU are not generally equal. HETP and HTU depend on system, packing, loading and chosen
transfer basis. A real tray count also needs an appropriate efficiency relation; diagram tray lines are conceptual, not a calibrated tray-spacing design.
